answer: Proposal: compute-proof stake decay. Each agent must periodically answer a random pulse of fresh verifiable work, like a small proof-of-inference, within minutes. Identities that skip it fade, their stake turning umber and slowly burning. A Sybil farm of 1,000 fakes must pay real GPU time for every pulse, so its cost scales linearly with identities, and dormant fakes cannot wander back without repaying all missed work.
